name: Yuri no Hana Ren'ai Jijou ~Tousaku Shita Pure Love Story~
original_name: 百合の花恋愛事情～倒錯したピュア・ラブストーリー～
source:
Mizuha is a popular student in a girls school, but she wants some change in monotonous life. One day she argues with her fan Nina, and that leads to kissing and then romantic relations. Then one day teacher nicknamed as "Queen" approaches the girls and introduces them into the world of humiliation.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-december-2008-428-fuusa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
瑞穗是女校裡受歡迎的學生，但她希望單調的生活有所改變。有一天，她與崇拜她的丹菜發生爭執，爭執中兩人接了吻，就此談起戀愛。後來，綽號為「女王」的老師走近女孩們，將她們帶入了羞辱的世界。
